kitDescription: Julia (Treasure) is an Iron AR attacker who casts a 10-second self-buff window — generic Critical Rate 26.04%, ATK 20%, and a normal-attack-only Critical Rate 36.16% — automatically at battle start and then every 40 seconds. Landing critical hits with her normal fire builds Crescendo, a stacking Critical Damage buff (24.79% per stack, up to 5, lasting 15 seconds), and every 8 critical hits she fires Marcato, an 88%-of-ATK bonus hit at her target; when Marcato itself crits, a further 100%-of-ATK hit follows on the same target. Her burst unloads five sequential hits of 544.5% of final ATK on the enemy, and if Crescendo is at full stacks when she casts, a sixth 544.5% hit lands too. Because the burst resolves at cast, it lands before Full Burst opens and does not take the +50% Full Burst bonus.

verdictRationale: No REAL-GOTCHA. All four S5 reds classify as blind-test defects (F1 attribution filter catching Crown's grant; F2 an absolute-tolerance assertion on 129M totals blind to emergent gauge feedback; F3 a missing slug filter plus the documented burst consolidation; F4 a no-op counterfactual patch) — none implicates the driver override, and the discrimination F4 failed to provide is supplied by the driver's own J4 (2722.5→544.5 strict drop), so the blind-vs-driver divergence resolves as RECON_ERRORs and one documented ⚑, not signal. On substance the driver matches or beats both blind agents on every contested line: it enacts the battle-start force-cast the S6 override left inert, gates the max-stack bonus the S6 override fired unconditionally (verified against the S2b discriminator — the 5.4s opener correctly gets no bonus), and encodes the Marcato-crit rider as the calibrated EV the S2b reviewer independently proposed rather than S6's ~4.5× optimistic bound. The five ⚑s (crit-proxy hitCounts 19/25, EV rider 22.23, no-decay gate resource, burst consolidation, targeting collapse) are each documented with tier and measurement recipe. Same-model residual for the owner to spot-check: the 32.3% fight-averaged crit rate underpinning hitCount 19/25 and the 22.23% rider probability both rest on the driver's own uptime arithmetic (5×10s S1 windows) rather than a recording — a single focused-julia popup-cadence read (Crescendo stack accrual time, Marcato popup spacing, Marcato crit-pair ratio) would independently pin or refit all three at once, and the burst consolidation's Monte-Carlo variance difference (1 roll vs 5) is worth a glance if seeded runs are ever graded on her.
